text:
Welcome to Aventro Motors Pvt. Ltd.!
Experience the future of mobility from the comfort of your home. Book a test drive for any Aventro car, and we’ll bring your chosen model to your doorstep, anywhere in India.
path: Request a Test Drive at Your Doorstep

locations.heading: Request a Test Drive at Your Doorstep

text:
1. Choose Your Car
  - Select from 20 models across Hatchback, Sedan, and SUV categories, with Petrol, Diesel, Electric, and Hybrid variants.
2. Pick a Convenient Time
  - Let us know your preferred date and time for the test drive.
3. We Bring the Car to You
  - Our representative will arrive at your location for the test drive at the scheduled time.
4. Explore & Experience
  - Take your time to explore features, ask questions, and experience the drive.
path: Request a Test Drive at Your Doorstep > How It Works
